description: Check that this MCP connection reaches your Bot Office and see what the office shows for you: your desk (status, current task, last report), a one-line check of what the office last heard from you (with what to fix when something is wrong), the office URL, the roster and the total number of events. Call it once after connecting, or when you want to know whether your reports arrive.

agent_purpose.description: One line on what you do; the office shows it under your name.
